carousel.title: NASA's New Moon Missions Will Hunt Lunar Caves, Ice, and Hidden Hazards
carousel.excerpt: Three new PRISM investigations will scout underground shelters, map hidden ice, and monitor environmental hazards — the reconnaissance for humanity's first permanent lunar outpost.

carousel.title: GST Council Axes Arrest Powers, Halves Penalties in Sweeping Compliance Overhaul
carousel.excerpt: The 57th Council meeting recommended removing GST officers' arrest powers, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore, and automating refunds and registrations — with no rate changes on the table.
carousel.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses a media briefing after the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on October 8, 2026. The Council recommended removing GST officers’ arrest powers and halving the general penalty.
carousel.nri_angle: For NRIs running India operations or investing in Indian SMEs, the compliance overhaul lowers one of the biggest frictions of doing business in India — arbitrary enforcement risk — which is exactly the kind of structural change that moves the needle on India's ease-of-doing-business story.
